texts: good. the cold wind, its return, the brief duration, the night, and day 251 of Year 1 are all carried, with the wind correctly treated as undergoing the return rather than willing it. The only loss is that our day term cannot mark 251 as a day-of-the-year rather than a day-of-the-month, and no rewrite of the sentence repairs that.

good. the lantern's link to the Harbor Station, the holding of salt-bloom (typed as a kind of bloom), and the mire-essence as the lantern's own part and as where the salt-bloom is held are all covered.
good. short and explicit, and both the wind and the lantern are reused from the earlier sentences instead of being re-introduced as new things.
good. "stayed lit" comes out as a lit state of the lantern that held and continued, so both "was the lantern lit?" and "did it stay lit?" resolve.
